name: dogfood-llm-prompt-injection-defense-app
description: Dogfood app v1.38-2 — a Prompt injection + Guardrails defense service that drives an LLM safety surface backed by @kiwa-lab/ai-llm v0.4 semantics (prompt-injection direct/indirect/jailbreak/role-hijacking + guardrails schema/regex/toxicity/PII/Constitutional), runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Anthropic Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + budget guard are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory injection classifier + guardrail pipeline) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/ai-llm @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
